prompt: Complete `makeCounter` so each call to the returned function returns the next number, starting at `start`. Two counters must not share state.
Fix `average` so it returns the mean of the list, or `None` for an empty list.
Return every customer's `name` and their number of orders as `orders`, including customers with no orders. Order by `name`.

coding.starterCode:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.name;
coding.referenceSolution:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.name;
